title: Aloo paneer koftha
howToPrepare:
Ingredients:

    boiled potato

        grated Paneer

        Tomatoes

        onion

        red chilli powder 

        coriander powder

        cumin powder

        turmeric powder

        garam masala

        corn flour

        How to prepare:
        step 1 : In a bowl add boiled aloo grated paneer, chillies, coriander powder,cumin powder
        for binding add 2 tablespoon corn flour and mix well and make small dumplings and deep fry until it turns golden brown.
        For gravy: In a pan add 2 tablespoon oil and add some cumin seeds and fry onion until brown add cashews and fry for few minutes 
        now grind it into smooth paste. Now in another pan add some oil or butter now add ground mixture and tomato puree 
        we need 3 tomatoes for puree fry for 5 minutes till the raw smell is  gone now add coriander powder, 
        turmeric powder 1/2 spoon, red chilli powder and cumin powder add some water and boil for 5 minutes 
        and now we can add some milk and fried dumplings and serve this with chapathi, roti, naan or rice .
